<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[You Don't Smell Right](/Feats.aspx?ID=5502) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486)

</column>

---

You can sniff out fellow werecreatures and master impersonators alike. You gain [scent](/Rules.aspx?ID=417) as an [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) sense with a range of 30 feet or extend the range of your scent by 30 feet. When a creature that's transformed into another form or is [Impersonating](/Actions.aspx?ID=2388) a specific creature passes within range of your scent ability, the GM rolls a secret Perception check for you to realize that the creature is transformed, even if you didn't spend an action to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301). When you actively Seek a creature within range of your scent, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception check to determine if it's disguised.
name: You Don't Smell Right
